topics.title: Write about the advantages and disadvantages of the mobile phone
guiding_questions: What are the advantages of using a mobile phone?
What are the disadvantages of using a mobile phone?
How can we use mobile phones wisely?
topics.sample_essay: The mobile phone is a very useful invention. It has many advantages. First, it helps us to contact our friends and family easily. We can also use it to listen to music, play games and chat with others. However, there are some disadvantages. Using the mobile phone too much can affect our health. It can also cause accidents if we use it while driving. In my opinion, we should use mobile phones wisely and not spend too much time on them.

topics.title: Write about the advantages and disadvantages of social media
guiding_questions: What are the advantages of social media?
What are the disadvantages of social media?
How can we use social media safely?
topics.sample_essay: Social media has become an important part of our lives. It has many advantages. It helps us to stay in contact with our friends and family. It also helps us to learn new things and share information. However, there are some disadvantages. Some people use fake accounts to trick others. Social media can also waste a lot of our time. In my opinion, we should use social media carefully and set a time limit for using it.
